messages:
lucy: Quick triage 10am 1) marketplace onramp items: H100 partner image, B200 burst SKU, MI300 pilot, Gaudi SI integration. Need final gating checklist + owner per item.

ryan: I'll own H100 image gating. Current risk: partner image not signed with our cosign policy. Partner provided `partner/h100:release-2024-06` but cosign sig missing. Asking partner to re-upload with cosign.

tessa: Partnerships ask: can we promise a live SKU by 2024-06-14? Marketing wants a firm cutover window for the marketplace. They need embargo windows and a short partner-facing checklist.

vikram: Infra check: B200 capacity is fine for burst, but autotune jobs caused memory spikes in canary (see logs). Filed ENGOPS-6721. Also, Gaudi lab -> SI VPN is flaky; packets dropped intermittently.

lau-legal: NDA gating 1) partner IP review incomplete for MI300 model bundle; we need the partner IP attestation form signed before public listing. I'll ping the partner legal contact.

lucy: Action: Ryan = cosign & image verification, Vikram = B200 perf triage + VPN flakiness, Tessa = coordinate partner-ready checklist & embargo, Lau = obtain signed attestation. Reconvene Tue 9am PT.

ryan: Quick runbook snippet for image verification I'll post to the marketplace repo:
```
# verify cosign signature
cosign verify --key $COSIGN_PUB partner/h100:release-2024-06
# verify digest
docker pull partner/h100:release-2024-06
docker inspect --format='{{index .RepoDigests 0}}' partner/h100:release-2024-06
```

vikram: ENGOPS-6721 has logs: `b200-node-17 oom at 2024-06-03T02:14:10Z` 1) running a patched kernel should reduce oom events, but need to validate with sustained batching (batch sizes 8-16).

tessa: Partner asks about split rollout: can we soft-launch MI300 to SIs only and then marketplace general for H100/B200? That would buy time for MI300 attestation.

lau-legal: We can approve MI300 soft-launch to SIs if partners sign an SI-limited addendum. Sending template now.

deploy-bot: Marketplace staging publish triggered for `partner/h100:release-2024-06` 1) status: pending cosign verification at 2024-06-04T15:20:01Z.

ryan: Noted. If cosign fails, fallback: use our verified image `redwood/h100:verified-2024-05` as marketplace placeholder and tag partner for follow-up.

vikram: For the VPN flakes I'm scheduling a maintenance window Fri 01:00-02:00 PT to repro with packet captures. Will attach pcap to ENGOPS-6721.

lucy: Tentative milestones set: cosign verified by 2024-06-06; MI300 attestation signed by 2024-06-07; B200 perf signoff by 2024-06-08; marketplace soft date (SI-only) 2024-06-14; GA publish target 2024-06-28 (subject to final QA). All ok with those dates?

tessa: Those dates work from partnership side but please flag any slip early so marketing can adjust comms.

lau-legal: NDA + attestation in progress. Expect partner sign-off by 2024-06-05 if no legal back-and-forth.

ryan: I'll post cosign status in this thread when done. If partner delay >48h we use placeholder image as Ryan described.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy complete on gaudi-int-2 1) success 1) 2024-06-03T08:45:12Z :white_check_mark:

lucy: Thanks everyone 1) owners: ryan=image, vikram=infra & perf, tessa=partner comms, lau=legal gating. Next sync Tue 9am PT.
